colours.name: Play Red & Play Yellow
alts: Zig Zag Slide red and yellow zig zag slide with steel ladder

data.description: Sharp turns from a 7 ft start make this Zig Zag Slide one of the liveliest rides in our individual equipment range. Children climb a steel ladder and then switch direction several times in a red and yellow chute on the way down. The height and the turns together suit older children who find low slides too easy. The zig zag shape also means the slide covers its drop in less length than a straight slide, which helps on a narrow school or society plot. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded parts on the Zig Zag are covered for 3 years. Ask us for a layout drawing showing the slide and its exit.

items.pText: Sharp turns from a 7 ft start make this Zig Zag Slide one of the liveliest rides in our individual equipment range. Children climb a steel ladder and then switch direction several times in a red and yellow chute on the way down. The height and the turns together suit older children who find low slides too easy. The zig zag shape also means the slide covers its drop in less length than a straight slide, which helps on a narrow school or society plot. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded parts on the Zig Zag are covered for 3 years. Ask us for a layout drawing showing the slide and its exit.

This slide stands on a galvanised steel ladder and frame with a moulded zig zag bed. Our team grouts it or installs it self-standing. Keep an impact-absorbing surface under the full footprint, since the turns pass close to the ground on both sides, and check each bend for cracks during maintenance.
